<Subject 2>: the same 17-year-old girl in a close-up portrait, wavy auburn-red hair, Asian oval face, single eyelids, red and yellow striped scarf, [Picture 2]

Warm firelight flickers steadily across her face, sparks drifting up from that same single fire. Color grade: warm firelight against dark teal, high contrast cinematic.
